meta.name: Eyes of Wakanda
meta.description:
Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

videos.title: Into the Lion's Den
videos.overview: A former member of the Dora Milaje is sent to take down a rogue Wakandan known as The Lion.

videos.title: Legends and Lies
videos.overview: Amidst the Trojan War, a soldier attempts to breach the city's defenses to retrieve an artifact.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: A powerful stowaway infiltrates the Golden City and threatens the secrets kept within.

videos.title: The Last Panther
videos.overview: Two Wakandans must choose to complete their mission or defy their homeland and save their world.
